scope: Only exposed 2002-169 ODE V2.0 format-2 development file; format check, no calibration or gravity inference
semantic_limits: Reference high/low concatenation checks binary payload identity; it does not identify a reference as sky/transponder/receiver/transmitter frequency or supply a ramp policy.
Item 21 is not a compression duration for range records; the author currently uses compression summaries only for Doppler groups.
The label midpoint, bias, transponder and reference-frequency definitions must control later observation conversion; later ODF specifications are not applied.
Nominal label-epoch arithmetic is not a station time-scale or relativistic clock conversion.
Ramp frequency uses GHz + Hz modulo 1e9 + nanohertz; it is not the orbit-record 46-bit millihertz field.
